so_what: brobertson2 is 0-3 and lost Achane for the year on top of A.J. Brown's IR stint; Kamara, also his, takes New Orleans's backfield with a full point per catch, and he is the league's most motivated RB and WR buyer.
ChrisHasAfib (3-0) gained most from the injury wave: Addison's 36% share and Malik Washington's sustained 27% are target volume that full PPR pays twice, so expect him to hold both.
kimberosburn has Caleb Williams, Collins and Coker on the report, but Shough covers QB and Collins may return Sunday; a 1-2 churner likely to bid at WR.
Gordon is less of a prize in full PPR: 3 targets on 20 touches is a rushing role, while Denver's split tilts toward Harvey's catches (nDabb's) over Dobbins's carries (haleymegert's).
sierragrace (0-3) lost Etienne, got a no-touchdown Hurts night and may see Schultz lose volume to a returning Collins; a candidate to trade for immediate points.
With 84 startable RB/WR slots, every wallet at 100 FAAB, five rosters RB-weak and two more just losing a starter, lead backs will draw more bidders here than in either other league.
